environment.topology: embedded PostgreSQL over real TCP connections

experiments.title: BusinessScope is mandatory at repository construction
experiments.expected: The compiler rejects missing, raw-string, and lookalike scopes
experiments.observed: tsc exited 0 while three @ts-expect-error assertions were consumed

experiments.title: Runtime tests use a separately authenticated PostgreSQL connection
experiments.expected: The session login is unprivileged and can assume only barber_runtime
experiments.observed: session_user=barber_runtime_harness_login; current_user=barber_runtime

experiments.title: Public resolver fails closed with two public Businesses
experiments.expected: No browser-provided id selects one of two candidates
experiments.observed: BUSINESS_SCOPE_AMBIGUOUS; observedCount=2

experiments.title: Public Business is resolved server-side
experiments.expected: An untrusted browser business_id cannot override the singleton

experiments.title: Admin Business is resolved from admin_auth_user_id
experiments.expected: Known admin maps to its Business; unknown admin fails closed
experiments.observed: known=00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000b2; unknown=ADMIN_NOT_AUTHORIZED

experiments.title: Public resolver fails closed with zero eligible Businesses
experiments.expected: Zero candidates returns an application error, not an unscoped query
experiments.observed: BUSINESS_SCOPE_NOT_FOUND

experiments.title: Repository queries isolate two test Businesses
experiments.expected: Lists, reads, and writes always include the resolved scope
experiments.observed: A lists only A; A cannot read/update B; B cannot read A

experiments.title: Direct runtime SQL is intentionally not tenant-isolated
experiments.expected: The experiment identifies that row filtering belongs to Persistence/Application
experiments.observed: raw authorized SQL observed 2 Businesses; repository SQL observed one

experiments.title: Appointment cannot reference a Service from another Business
experiments.expected: Composite FK rejects the insert
experiments.observed: insert or update on table "appointment" violates foreign key constraint "appointment_service_business_fk"; connectionReusable=true

experiments.observed: no privileges were granted for "service"; aclChanged=false; connectionReusable=true

experiments.title: Minimum runtime role can perform required domain DML
experiments.expected: SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE succeed on allowlisted objects and columns
experiments.observed: Business safe-column UPDATE and Service/Customer/Appointment/Occupancy INSERT succeeded

experiments.expected: Private schema ACL rejects direct SQL even independently of API schema configuration
experiments.observed: permission denied for schema app_private; connectionReusable=true

experiments.title: API roles can access only the intended public positive control
experiments.expected: anon/authenticated SELECT succeeds while app_private SELECT fails
experiments.observed: Both roles read exactly one RLS-protected public control row

experiments.title: Browser configuration excludes database credentials and domain repositories
experiments.expected: Only public Supabase Auth configuration crosses the browser boundary
experiments.observed: Static scan and runtime key inspection found no DATABASE_URL, pg, or repository capability

experiments.title: Private schemas are absent from the configured Data API schema allowlist
experiments.expected: Only public and graphql_public are exposed
experiments.observed: api.schemas=["public", "graphql_public"]

experiments.title: Runtime role has explicit least privileges
experiments.expected: No login/admin attributes, no DELETE/DDL, and only allowlisted domain DML
experiments.observed: Catalog ACL matrix and role attributes match the declared policy

experiments.title: Future app_private objects do not inherit Data API role grants
experiments.expected: Migration contains explicit owner-scoped default privilege revokes
experiments.observed: Static migration assertion passed; current object ACLs independently verified in pg_catalog

postgresql: minimal runtime role attributes and object/column grants
composite foreign keys against cross-Business references
transaction abort and explicit rollback after SQL errors
applicationPersistence: business_id predicate in every Business-owned repository operation
deliberatelyNotClaimed: database-enforced row isolation for arbitrary runtime SQL
full multi-tenant routing, membership, or RLS
hosted Data API HTTP behavior (requires managed-environment probe)
